Strategy: Try the untried exact-fit-only family: score an exact fit far above everything else, and score all other bins equally, so ties fall to the earliest bin. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever no exact fit exists, since Best Fit takes the tightest bin and this rule takes the first feasible bin. Exact fits are never missed, but first-fit order ignores tightness and can waste space across many bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) for r in bins]
```
